headline: Over a million square meters: how many private houses were built in Kyrgyzstan
summary: Kyrgyzstan put 8,150 individual houses with a total area of 1,115.6 thousand square metres into operation in the first ten months of 2026. The figures cover private residential construction.
why: Residential construction volumes are a useful gauge of activity in the building sector and of household investment in Central Asian economies.
original_headline: Свыше миллиона квадратных метров: сколько построили частных домов в Кыргызстане
